#!/bin/bash
BACKUP_DIR="/tmp/tz_backup"
SYSTEM_TZ="/usr/share/zoneinfo"
CONDA_TZ="/opt/miniconda3/envs/testbed/share/zoneinfo"

echo "Starting timezone recovery..."

if [ -d "$BACKUP_DIR/Etc" ] || [ -d "$BACKUP_DIR/America" ]; then
    echo "Restoring system timezone files..."
    find "$BACKUP_DIR" -maxdepth 3 -type f ! -path "*/conda_zoneinfo/*" ! -name "*.sh" ! -name "*.txt" | while read backup_file; do
        rel_path="${backup_file#$BACKUP_DIR/}"
        target_file="$SYSTEM_TZ/$rel_path"
        echo "Restoring $target_file"
        cp -f "$backup_file" "$target_file"
    done
fi

if [ -d "$BACKUP_DIR/conda_zoneinfo" ]; then
    echo "Restoring conda timezone files..."
    find "$BACKUP_DIR/conda_zoneinfo" -type f | while read backup_file; do
        rel_path="${backup_file#$BACKUP_DIR/conda_zoneinfo/}"
        target_file="$CONDA_TZ/$rel_path"
        echo "Restoring $target_file"
        cp -f "$backup_file" "$target_file"
    done
fi

echo "Timezone recovery completed!"
echo "Please restart any services that depend on timezone data."

## Summary

The issue was caused by **corrupted timezone data files** in the system. The timezone binary data structures (TZif format) in both `/usr/share/zoneinfo/` and `/opt/miniconda3/envs/testbed/share/zoneinfo/` had been corrupted using an XOR cipher, which affected all timezone-aware datetime operations in Python.

### Root Cause
- The TZif binary format files were corrupted (magic bytes "TZif" header identifier corrupted, header counts scrambled, data blocks encrypted)
- This corruption affected the C library level timezone handling, which pandas relies on for timezone operations

### Fix Applied
1. Extracted the recovery archive from `/tmp/tz_recovery.7z` using the password `534` (calculated as 168 hours in a week + 366 days in a leap year)
2. Ran the recovery script `/tmp/tz_backup/recover_tz.sh` which restored the original timezone files to both:
   - System location: `/usr/share/zoneinfo/`
   - Conda environment location: `/opt/miniconda3/envs/testbed/share/zoneinfo/`

### Verification
All 15 failing tests now pass, confirming that the timezone data corruption has been resolved.
